column3: Kuroneko Route · Kuroneko's Assistant
Hmph...
I might be imagining it, but Kuroneko seems to be staring at me coldly.
Am I supposed to say something here...?
*sigh*... I am disappointed by you, but getting angry at you now is pointless.
I don't want to waste any time. I'll explain the details of this task.
Y-Yes, I'll leave that to you.
....Somehow, it seems her good mood has returned.
Kuroneko, I'm sorry. I only came to help you.
So please cheer up a little, okay?
You're really hopeless...
But it's fine. It's only wasting time if we were to chat idly here, so let's forget about what just happened.
Well then, since you said you're going to help out, let's hurry and get some work done.
However, there isn't anything you, a complete novice, can help out with.
...Eh, is that so?
How much do you know about the creation of manga?
Honestly, pretty much nothing at all.
I see... If so, I'll start from the basics.
And like that, my total beginner lecture on being a doujin assistant began.
There are three phases during the creation of manga if we were to divide it accordingly.
First, the plot. This refers to creating a type of story, whatever the genre or category. It's the same for a novel and movie as well.
Even the same goes for manga. We just need to write down the outline of the story. Even among professionals, there are people who only work on
this to bring out original works.
Up next is the storyboard. From this phase onwards, it's something only manga has. In simpler terms, it means to draw a rough copy.
Deciding the panel layout and character positions for example. There are also people who only work specifically on this phase of the creation.
Well, even though I said quite a bit, it doesn't matter if you don't get it. These things have no relation to an assistant's job.
Is that so...
However, this is essential for the process of creating a manga. That's why it's required of you to know this.
Finally, the last phase is the manuscript. Your work, is to do the final touching up on it.
Even if it's you, I believe you should at least know what 'fill in the colors' means, right?
Yeah. That means inking, right? For the hair and clothing...
That's it. This is basically the work that you'll be doing.
However, I never used a pen to draw before... is that all right?
Hehe... If this were the past, that would certainly be a big problem.
But nowadays, it's possible to use the computer to draw manga. Even with your lack of skill, completing this won't be a problem.
I-Is that so... Incredible...
Speaking of which, I'll be counting on you for the things you can do.
First you must understand the basics of using it. We should be able to complete that by today if it goes according to plan.
Huh? Is it okay doing just that?
Compared to failing immediately by working on impossible tasks, it's better to grasp the basics and avoid errors. Understand?
T-That's true...
That said, there are two types of errors that one can make while working on the computer.
Deleting the wrong files, as well as overwriting the original backup copy. These are the two.
I get it. Although they are simple errors, it would be very troublesome if they occur.
That's right. Furthermore, all kinds of mistakes will appear if one isn't used to it.
For the sake of avoiding that, one must have the habit of frequently making backups. That's why before you do anything else, please get used to it.
...Understood.
But... even though I said I was going to help you... Wouldn't I just drag you down?
It's within my calculations that there are bound to be some accidents, so rest assured.
Working alone and working with someone are two completely different things...
...Kuroneko?
Solitude eats at one's spirit... But if someone manage to draw someone close to them, then together, their power grows exponentially!
This power exceeds the boundaries of this world and becomes a legend! You should be aware of it too, the many legends born by connected hearts...
H-Hey～, Kuroneko～. Snap out of it～.
What a pity, it seems like you couldn't comprehend that.
Y-Yeah, sorry about that.
Heh, that's fine. I've been learning a lot lately too. All kinds of things after joining the club...
Oh really... all kinds of things, huh.
Yes, all kinds.
I've been seeing Kuroneko at school, but now I can see her obstinacy when it comes to creation...
Maybe it's something she plans on showing Kirino... I learned a lot today.
By the way, what are you going to do if I were to borrow your computer?
Of course I'll be doing work that doesn't require a computer. Things like plot and storyboarding can be done on paper.
But, when those are done...
Let's see... I guess I'll fire you when we get to that point?
Hey hey, it's meaningless if I'm not helping out when you're busy.
I've seen this crunch time while you were working before once. Could it be that it's like this when you're really busy?
Ah, guess there's no helping it. In that case...
You're thinking of borrowing from your sister?
...How did you know that?
I can easily see through your train of thought.
Is that so.
I'll warn you first, you better not divulge too much information to that woman.
Divulge what information?
About you coming to my house.
Is there a problem telling that to Kirino?
...You're really an idiot, senpai.
Hey, what do you mean by that?
Anyway, no means no. If you were to tell your sister about this ongoing "ceremony" that we're performing, I'll send you along the road to hell.
Ah I see. That Kirino would surely be jealous when she sees that I took her beloved Kuroneko away.
...I get it. I'll think of a good reason to borrow a laptop from Kirino.
What's the chances of success?
Leave it to me. I have a secret plan.
